messages:
anya: quick run posted — confidence-gating prototype on the new 30b-quant model. tl;dr: ~1.8x tokens/s improvement, small hit on long-form quality. details below. @sarah @kevin please eyeball the eval slices.

sarah: ack. link? :eyes:

anya: https://internal.redwood/bench/1715209999 — run id: cg-030b-q1

kevin: quick numbers? p50/p95 and throughput?

anya: p50 gen latency down 28%, p95 down 15%. throughput +80% at batch=8. quality: conv-length>512 slices show ~2.1% exact-match drop, LM PPL +0.6.

jia: how are you gating — threshold on top1 softmax or entropy?

anya: entropy threshold on next-token logits, fallback to full-sample-decoder when entropy < 0.5. implemented as per-token early-stop that skips expensive sampling when confident. also got a small cache hit increase since partial KV states are reused.

bench-bot: run cg-030b-q1 completed on pod gpu-cluster-7 (8xA100). artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/cg-030b-q1 ; logs archived.

mike: can you paste the exact command? want to repro locally.

anya: here:
```
python bench_decode.py --model /models/30b-quant --strategy confidence_gate --threshold 0.5 --batch 8 --prompt-set longform_v2 --metrics all
```

sarah: sampling settings unchanged? temp/topk?

anya: kept temperature=0.7, top_k=50; only change is token-level gate. no seed or sampling-mode changes.

kevin: any bias or safety regressions on the slices we care about? prompt-ensemble tests?

anya: quick safety check: no degenerate repetitions. small uptick in factual hallucinations on technical Q&A slice (recall down ~3%). attaching per-slice CSV to the run artifacts.

mike: can we run an entropy threshold sweep? try 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6 and also gate only after token 128 to reduce prefix noise.

anya: agreed. scheduling sweep now. will also run with int8 vs int4 quant variants to see interaction with gating.

jia: ops heads-up: previous KV reuse changes caused OOM on 8xA100 when cache aggressive. set max_kv_memory=6GB for this sweep to be safe.

anya: got it — setting max_kv_memory=6G and requeueing.

sarah: if threshold=0.5 preserves quality on the critical slices, this looks like a good Dedicated capacity knob for throughput/cost. ping me when you have the sweep summary. :thumbsup:

anya: will post consolidated results + CSVs to the run page when done. thanks all!
